description: Citation-grade signal excerpts for Hermes synthesis. Every claim in output must map to one of these signal ids.

signals.raw_text: Semitexa Platform UI: LLM proposes seed/algorithm/knobs/mood; deterministic OKLCH pipeline emits identical token sets for the same inputs. OutputValidator enforces JSON schema, hex, OKLCH envelope, and WCAG contrast. Includes eval artifacts and skin.json history. Seed mode produces the same 41 tokens every time without an LLM.

Creative AI Workflow Lab: Figma development plugin calls a backend-owned workflow for copy generation, localization, image placeholder jobs, usage metering, and audit records. Architecture slice demonstrates boundaries expensive to retrofit: backend-owned policy, profile context, async asset jobs, explicit apply/audit records.

Accessible Design System: accessibility-first, token-driven system for AI-assisted interface generation. GitHub is canonical source for tokens, component specs, accessibility rules, and AI prompt templates. Philosophy: accessibility by default, semantic tokens over hardcoded values, machine-readable component specifications, AI as accelerator not replacement for design judgement.
design-ai: corpus of product DESIGN.md files (Stripe and others) describing UI architecture, tokens, and patterns. Index markdown paths only; README zip funnels are not the corpus.
UX Collective thesis for Second Eye watch: best AI design tools improve user capability, not just speed. Useful for reaction and opinion beats about AI UX/UI tooling quality.
Figma blog and release notes: primary watch surface for AI UX/UI design tool changes, Config announcements, and design-to-code workflow updates.
Replit blog: primary watch surface for Replit Agent, design-to-code, and AI-assisted app builder workflow changes relevant to UX/UI design tooling.
Figma release notes: canonical watch surface for shipped Figma AI, design-to-code, Dev Mode, and Config feature changes — use for reaction beats on tool updates, not blog opinion pieces.

pixel-mcp-workflow: Figma MCP workflow for design operations — connects design tools to agent-accessible MCP surfaces. Index as methodology evidence for Figma MCP design workflows, not general agent engineering.

Second Eye editorial law: every synthesized artifact (reel, reaction, how-to, podcast, blog) must attach explicit citations to ontology entities and source signals. Opinion claims must be labeled opinion. Stage 2 output must match script metadata or reject. Human approves finished product before Space 3 publish.
